language.note: All step, quality and rework text is in English. The golden uses Hindi (Devanagari) body text.

summary: The generated WI describes the wrong process: a spot-welding assembly stage (welding fixture S-06221, 12 spot welds, spot welding gun No. 90, weld nuts, hand-off to Stage 2) instead of shearing, draw, trim & piercing and restrike on the 800 T and 500 T presses. An operator would get no press settings, no dimensions and no correct machines. Only the header identifiers, the part list row and two rework rows (dent → plastic mallet, rust → rust remover) are usable. Dates and unit are wrong, and all body text is in English instead of Hindi.
